name: Filtered nu-disco bass
desc: Modern filtered disco bass in C minor: driving 16th root-and-octave saw with a deep sidechain-feel pump and a 24db filter that blooms and closes over 16 cycles. Cm-Ab-Bb-Gm progression keeps it moving - Purple Disco Machine territory.

pump.doc: pump floor as fraction of gain

code.full: note("<[c2 c2 c3 c2]*4 [ab1 ab1 ab2 ab1]*4 [bb1 bb1 bb2 bb1]*4 [g1 g1 g2 g1]*4>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype("24db").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).lpq(5).attack(.004).decay(.14).sustain(.1).release(.04).shape(.35).gain(saw.range(${gain}*${pump}, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.08).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[c2 c2 c3 c2 c2 c3 c2 [c3 g2]]*2 [ab1 ab1 ab2 ab1 ab1 ab2 ab1 [ab2 eb2]]*2 [bb1 bb1 bb2 bb1 bb1 bb2 bb1 [bb2 f2]]*2 [g1 g1 g2 g1 g1 g2 g1 [g2 d2]]*2>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype("24db").lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*2).slow(8)).lpq(6).attack(.003).decay(.12).sustain(.09).release(.03).shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*${pump}, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.08).every(8, x=>x.hpf(200)).orbit(3).play()
